_comment: dx+xf (transformer encoder, default attention interaction — no bilinear, no mlp_logsig) coverage for every pretrain->finetune pair in vis/visualize_dataset_pairs.py's DATASET_PAIRS. Scoped to what's actually missing rather than re-running everything: the 12 FD-*->FD-* hub-and-spoke directions already have 10-seed dx+xf baseline (random-init) runs from experiments_baselines.json, so those blocks add only the matching finetune (pretrained-weights) runs at the same ep2/10 budget so their (view, ep, config) key lines up with the existing baseline for the plot. SleepEEG->{FD-A,FD-B,FD-C,FD-D} and ECG->{Epilepsy,FD-A,FD-B,FD-C,FD-D} have no dx+xf data at all yet, so those blocks schedule both finetune and baseline. SleepEEG->EMG and ECG->EMG are intentionally omitted: no _DA_EMG_256_00 preprocessed data (or raw EMG/ source directory) exists in this checkout, so those pairs can't be run yet. encoder_type and interaction_type both omitted throughout (default transformer / attention). Run with: python scripts/run_experiments.py experiment_configs/experiments_dxxf_pairs_completion.json --gpus 6,7,8
_important_harth_har70plus: HARTH<->HAR70plus use PAIR_METRIC='f1_subject_macro' in vis/visualize_dataset_pairs.py (not accuracy), which needs the subject_ids-aware get_clf_metrics() path in src/evaluation.py / scripts/run_finetune.py -- as of this writing that path is only an UNCOMMITTED working-tree change, never yet exercised by a completed run. Every existing dx+xf run for both directions (old archives AND the prior current-out_finetune baseline files for HAR70plus->HARTH) predates that code and has f1_subject_macro=None, so neither direction could show a point until BOTH modes are freshly run under the current code. The 10 stale HAR70plus->HARTH baseline files (and their final_test_metric_summary.tsv rows) have already been renamed in place with a '_pre_subject_wise_old' suffix -- kept for reference, but out of the way of both the run_finetune.py exists-check and vis/visualize_dataset_pairs.py's RUN_RE (which requires the run_name to end exactly in finetune/baseline/freeze) -- so their original run_names are free and both blocks below (run_modes=finetune,baseline) will execute cleanly without deleting anything. HARTH->HAR70plus had no current-out_finetune files at all to begin with (its dx+xf data only ever lived in the old archives).
